description:
Cost: free. Export an agent's own settlement audit trail: every settlement decided under its X-Agent-Id, with the KYA tier, mandate decision, policy decision, sanctions screen and oracle state recorded at the time, whether the paying wallet was the agent's registered wallet, and a SHA-256 digest of the export. Readable only by the agent's registered wallet: supply walletSignature, walletTimestamp and walletNonce — an EIP-191 signature over "DPX-KYA-AUDIT
<agentId>
<timestamp_ms>
<nonce>" (see GET https://compliance.untitledfinancial.com/agent/auth-spec). Supports json or csv.

agentId.description: Agent ID (agt_...). The agent must have registered a walletAddress.

from.description: Optional ISO date: earliest settlement to include.

to.description: Optional ISO date: latest settlement to include.

walletNonce.description: Single-use nonce used in the signed message (8–128 chars).

walletSignature.description: EIP-191 signature from the agent's registered wallet over the DPX-KYA-AUDIT message.

walletTimestamp.description: Milliseconds since epoch used in the signed message (±5 min).

name: agent.audit_export

exportDigest.description: SHA-256 of the events array as returned.
